description: Zcash NFT projects shown on ZScan. Every fact cites a public source. `kind` says where the items live and how far ZScan can verify them: inscription (Zcash transparent inscriptions, indexed from the chain), marketplace (a venue's own records), zsa-testnet (Zcash Shielded Assets on testnet), other-chain, upcoming (not minted). `onchain` links a project to what ZScan detects on chain: a ZRC-721 collection name or a launchpad drop (the address every mint paid). `market` names a supported marketplace API. PRs welcome.

projects.name: Zemon
projects.description: 6,666 masked pixel-art faces inscribed on Zcash through the Zerdinals launchpad (IPFS images), traded on the non-custodial Zemon market.

sources.label: zemon.cash lists Zemon #0 as inscription 5a08f8cb…35afi0, minted in this drop
